summary: Adds AddIndex.reduce to cancel a matching AddIndex/RemoveIndex pair during migration optimization, matching Django's established reduce() pattern. Correct, minimal fix; index names are globally unique so omitting a model_name check is safe.

issues.description: Only handles AddIndex+RemoveIndex cancellation. Other reducible pairs (e.g. RemoveIndex+AddIndex, RenameIndex interactions) not covered, but those are out of scope for the stated issue and can land separately.
